C1375.title: Mt. Gox Exchange Private Key Leak Leads to Theft of 850,000 Bitcoin
C1375.summary: Between 2011 and 2014, Mt. Gox exchange suffered a theft of over 850,000 Bitcoin due to leaked private keys and unaudited vulnerabilities. The exchange repeatedly reused Bitcoin addresses with compromised keys, escalating the loss into the largest cryptocurrency theft in history.
